title: Sell one orange house when mortgages are insufficient
description: Sell one orange house when mortgages are insufficient. Mortgage value is insufficient; sell evenly and keep the monopoly alive. The key distinction is whether a non-core mortgage, building sale, or bankruptcy is actually sufficient in this debt state.

final_action.public_message: I need cash, selling all my houses on the orange set.
final_action.private_thought: Selling 6 houses yields $300, covering the $280 rent owed. This preserves my utilities for future income.

breakdown.message: Chooses sell_houses_or_hotel for this liquidation state.
Sells buildings only after non-core mortgages cannot cover the debt.
Private thought names the liquidation tradeoff.
